title: Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 19b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.19b.2) Rav Nachman came to Sura and they asked him; he said to them: “Is this not what Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi said — that slaughtering done like a comb is valid?” Hyman infers from this that he was older than Rav Nachman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: In the linked passage, Rav Nachman answers a question in Sura by citing Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi’s ruling.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=532&lang=en) cites the same exchange. The relative ages are Hyman’s inference.
